xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2838: Project settings disclosure: static 'collapsed' badge + panel missing for projects with no in-flight issues

plan.title: Project settings disclosure: static 'collapsed' badge + panel missing for projects with no in-flight issues
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The cockpit Project settings disclosure (ProjectOverview.tsx:398-406) hardcodes badges={['collapsed']} — an open panel still shows a pill reading 'collapsed', and the collapsed row communicates nothing about the actual auto-merge/swarm values. Separately, the disclosure only renders inside the cockpit branch of ProjectHome (features.length > 0), so a registered project with zero in-flight pipeline issues (e.g. Mind Your Now) has no dashboard surface at all to view or change its project-scoped auto-merge default or swarm policy, even though the /api/projects/:key/auto-merge-default and /api/projects/:key/swarm-policy endpoints work fine.
narratives.Proposal: Extract ProjectSettingsSection + ProjectDisclosure into a shared ProjectSettingsDisclosure component (CommandDeck/ProjectSettingsDisclosure.tsx). Replace the static badge with a pure-CSS rotating chevron (Tailwind group/group-open:rotate-90) and render the current setting values as plain muted text in the collapsed summary, read from the same react-query keys the panel already uses. Render the shared component from both the cockpit (unchanged position) and the sparse fallback branch of ProjectHome, gated on projectKey truthiness (the settings routes are exact-key lookups via getProjectSync). Cover with component tests for the affordance/summary and ProjectHome tests for the sparse path; update docs/SWARM-POLICY.md and configuration/auto-merge.mdx.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No server/route changes: the settings endpoints keep their exact-projects.yaml-key lookup; no name-or-key resolution is added.
- No redesign of the settings controls themselves: the auto-merge segmented control, swarm select, and helper copy stay as-is (AC-4 no-loss).
- No ProjectReleasePanel, hero metrics, or other cockpit content added to the sparse fallback — only the Project settings disclosure.
- No settings surface for the 'No project' bucket (it has no projects.yaml key).
- No changes to per-issue swarm/auto-merge overrides or Issue Detail surfaces.

autoDecisions.summary: Hoist the settings disclosure into a shared component consumed by both ProjectOverview and ProjectHome's sparse branch, instead of duplicating the JSX in the sparse branch.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue offered both directions; duplication would drift the two copies. A single component file is the smallest no-drift shape and keeps the cockpit position unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate the sparse-branch settings on projectKey truthiness, not `projectKey ?? projectName` as the issue sketched.
autoDecisions.rationale: The settings routes call getProjectSync(key) (src/lib/projects.ts:580-583), an exact projects.yaml-key lookup — a display-name fallback would 404 and break saves. The release route the issue cited explicitly accepts name-or-key; the settings routes do not. projectKey is threaded from selectedRegisteredProject?.key (CommandDeck/index.tsx:1449) and is present for every registered project even with zero features, so AC-3 still holds.

autoDecisions.summary: Render collapsed-summary values from the same react-query keys via a lightweight inner component instead of lifting the queries.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue offered both; identical query keys share one cache entry (no extra fetch), and this avoids threading data props through the disclosure wrapper — the smaller diff.

autoDecisions.summary: Chevron affordance implemented as pure CSS: <details class='group'> + ChevronRight with 'transition-transform group-open:rotate-90' (Tailwind 3.4).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue explicitly asked for a chevron that rotates with details[open] via pure CSS, no state; Tailwind's group-open variant does exactly this and the file already mixes Tailwind classes with inline styles (ProjectOverview.tsx:288).

autoDecisions.summary: Summary values are plain --muted-foreground text, no pill badges, no decorative color.
autoDecisions.rationale: design/style-guide/STYLE-GUIDE.md forbids pill badges and decorative color; color is signal-only and static setting values are not live signals.

items.title: Extract ProjectSettingsSection + ProjectDisclosure into shared ProjectSettingsDisclosure.tsx

narrative.Action: PURE MOVE, no behavior change. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandDeck/ProjectSettingsDisclosure.tsx. Move ProjectSettingsSection (currently ProjectOverview.tsx:222-291) and ProjectDisclosure (currently ProjectOverview.tsx:544-609) into it verbatim, keeping query keys ['project-auto-merge-default', projectKey] and ['project-swarm-policy', projectKey] and their queryFns byte-identical (H1: ProjectOverview.test.tsx's strict fetch mock must keep matching). Export one composed component: `export function ProjectSettingsDisclosure({ projectKey }: { projectKey: string })` that renders <ProjectDisclosure title="Project settings" summary="Auto-merge default and project-level merge policy" badges={['collapsed']}><ProjectSettingsSection projectKey={projectKey} /></ProjectDisclosure> — exactly what ProjectOverview.tsx:399-405 renders today (the stale badge is removed by the next item, not this one). ProjectSettingsSection and ProjectDisclosure stay module-private (not exported). In ProjectOverview.tsx, replace the inline block at lines 398-406 with {projectKey && <ProjectSettingsDisclosure projectKey={projectKey} />}, import it, and delete the moved code plus now-unused imports that this move orphans (useMutation/useQueryClient remain used by HeroBillboard — verify before removing anything). Do not reformat or improve surrounding code.

narrative.Action: In ProjectSettingsDisclosure.tsx only. Add a module-private ProjectSettingsSummary({ projectKey }) component that calls useQuery with EXACTLY the same query keys and queryFns as ProjectSettingsSection: ['project-auto-merge-default', projectKey] and ['project-swarm-policy', projectKey] (identical keys share one react-query cache entry — no extra fetch; H1). It renders plain text, fontSize 12, color var(--muted-foreground), no border, no border-radius pill, no decorative color (style guide: color is signal-only; font-medium weight): first the auto-merge label mapped as 'auto'→'⚡ Auto', 'hold'→'🔒 Hold for UAT', null/undefined→'Global default'; then a middot separator; then the swarm mode mapped as configured.mode 'off'/'auto'/'always'→'Swarm off'/'Swarm auto'/'Swarm always', absent→'Swarm inherit'. Replace the static summary description text ('Auto-merge default and project-level merge policy') in the ProjectSettingsDisclosure composition with <ProjectSettingsSummary projectKey={projectKey} /> — change ProjectDisclosure's summary prop type from string to ReactNode to accept it. While data is loading, render nothing (empty summary values), not placeholders.

Component tests for the disclosure affordance, summary values, and no-loss panel content

narrative.Action: New file src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandDeck/__tests__/ProjectSettingsDisclosure.test.tsx. Copy the setup idiom from the sibling ProjectOverview.test.tsx: installStrictFetchMock handling GET/POST /api/projects/<key>/auto-merge-default and /api/projects/<key>/swarm-policy, a render() wrapper providing QueryClientProvider with retry:false, afterEach cleanup + assertNoUnexpectedRequests. HAZARD H2: jsdom does not reliably toggle <details> on summary click — assert the affordance structurally (details element has class 'group'; chevron svg has class 'group-open:rotate-90'), and drive open state by setting the open attribute, not by click. Tests: (1) renders no text 'collapsed' anywhere; (2) chevron present with rotation classes under the group details; (3) summary shows mapped values from fetched data (e.g. value:'hold' → '🔒 Hold for UAT', swarm mode 'auto' → 'Swarm auto'); (4) unconfigured → 'Global default' and 'Swarm inherit'; (5) no-loss: expanded content contains the three-option segmented control (⚡ Auto / 🔒 Hold for UAT / Global default buttons), the 'Project swarm policy' select, and both helper-copy strings; (6) clicking a segment POSTs to /api/projects/<key>/auto-merge-default with the chosen value.
